************************************************************
* INCLUDE LSNR1F01                                         *
* Interne Unterroutinen für Funktionsgruppe SNR1           *
* ADIC-Schnittstelle                                       *
************************************************************
* Routine bestimmt für eine Domäne die Entitytabelle
* und die Länge
form get_domain
     using    p_domain      type ddobjname
     changing p_datatype    type dd01v-datatype
              p_entitytab   type dd01v-entitytab
              p_length      type dd01v-leng.

  data: l_idderr   type dderr,
        l_gotstate type boolean.

  call function 'DDIF_DOMA_GET'
       exporting
         name          = p_domain
         state         = 'A'
         langu         = sy-langu
       importing
         gotstate      = l_gotstate
         dd01v_wa      = dd01v
       exceptions
         illegal_input = 1
         others        = 2.

  if sy-subrc <> 0 or l_gotstate = space.
    l_idderr-errnum = 4.
  endif.

  if l_idderr-errnum = 0.
    p_datatype  = dd01v-datatype.
    p_length    = dd01v-leng.
    p_entitytab = dd01v-entitytab.
  else.
    perform adic_message
            using l_idderr-errnum
                  'DOMA'
                  p_domain.
  endif.
endform.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM GET_ROLL
*       Routine bestimmt für ein Datenelement die Domäne
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
form get_roll
     using    p_rollname
     changing p_domlen
              p_domain   type dd03p-domname.

  data: l_idderr   type dderr,
        l_dummy1   type dd01v-datatype,
        l_dummy2   type dd01v-entitytab.
  data: l_gotstate type boolean.

  call function 'DDIF_DTEL_GET'
       exporting
         name                = p_rollname
         state               = 'A'
         langu               = sy-langu
       importing
         gotstate            = l_gotstate
         dd04v_wa            = dd04v
       exceptions
         illegal_input       = 1
         others              = 2.
   if sy-subrc <> 0 or l_gotstate = space.
     l_idderr-errnum = 4.
   endif.
  if l_idderr-errnum = 0.
    p_domain = dd04v-domname.
  else.
    perform adic_message
            using l_idderr-errnum
                  'DTEL'
                  p_rollname.
  endif.
  perform get_domain
          using    p_domain
          changing l_dummy1
                   l_dummy2
                   p_domlen.
endform.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM GET_FIELDS                                               *
* bestimmt für die Felder der Gruppentabelle die Attribute und
* stellt die Information in die Tabelle NTB_GROUP
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
form get_fields.

  data: l_dfies    type table of dfies,
        l_dfies_wa type dfies.

  refresh ntb_group.
  call function 'DDIF_FIELDINFO_GET'
       exporting
         tabname   = iobject-nrtab
       tables
         dfies_tab = l_dfies
       exceptions
         not_found = 1
        others    = 2.

  if sy-subrc = 0.
    loop at l_dfies into l_dfies_wa.
      if l_dfies_wa-fieldname = iobject-nrintfld   or
         l_dfies_wa-fieldname = iobject-nrextfld   or
         l_dfies_wa-fieldname = iobject-nrfld      or
         l_dfies_wa-fieldname = iobject-nrsobjfld  or
         l_dfies_wa-fieldname = iobject-nrelefld   or
         l_dfies_wa-datatype  = 'CLNT'.
        clear ntb_group.
        ntb_group-tabname   = l_dfies_wa-tabname.
        ntb_group-fieldname = l_dfies_wa-fieldname.
        ntb_group-position  = l_dfies_wa-position.
        ntb_group-intlen    = l_dfies_wa-leng.
        ntb_group-datatype  = l_dfies_wa-datatype.
        ntb_group-outputlen = l_dfies_wa-outputlen.
        ntb_group-convexit  = l_dfies_wa-convexit.
        ntb_group-offset    = l_dfies_wa-offset.
        ntb_group-scrtext_l = l_dfies_wa-scrtext_l.
        ntb_group-scrtext_m = l_dfies_wa-scrtext_m.
        ntb_group-scrtext_s = l_dfies_wa-scrtext_s.
        append ntb_group.
      endif.
    endloop.
  else.
    perform adic_message
            using sy-subrc
                  'TABL'
                  iobject-nrtab.      "INS
  endif.
endform.


*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM GET_ELEMFIELD                                            *
* bestimmt für eine Domäne mit Prüftabelle das Feld
* der Prüftabelle, an dem die Domäne hängt plus Offset und
* interne Länge des Feldes
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
form get_elemfield
     using    p_domain     type ddobjname
     changing p_ntb        type intb
              p_client_dep type c.

  data: l_table    type dd03p-tabname,
        l_dfies    type table of dfies,
        l_dfies_wa type dfies.

  perform get_domain
          using    p_domain
          changing p_ntb-datatype
                   l_table
                   p_ntb-intlen.

  call function 'DDIF_FIELDINFO_GET'
       exporting
         tabname   = l_table
       tables
         dfies_tab = l_dfies
       exceptions
         not_found = 1
         others    = 2.

  if sy-subrc = 0.
    loop at l_dfies into l_dfies_wa.
      if l_dfies_wa-domname = p_domain and l_dfies_wa-keyflag = 'X'.
        p_ntb-tabname   = l_dfies_wa-tabname.
        p_ntb-fieldname = l_dfies_wa-fieldname.
        p_ntb-position  = l_dfies_wa-position.
        p_ntb-intlen    = l_dfies_wa-intlen.
        p_ntb-datatype  = l_dfies_wa-datatype.
        p_ntb-outputlen = l_dfies_wa-outputlen.
        p_ntb-convexit  = l_dfies_wa-convexit.
        p_ntb-offset    = l_dfies_wa-offset.
        p_ntb-scrtext_l = l_dfies_wa-scrtext_l.
        p_ntb-scrtext_m = l_dfies_wa-scrtext_m.
        p_ntb-scrtext_s = l_dfies_wa-scrtext_s.
        exit.
      endif.
    endloop.
  else.
    perform adic_message
            using sy-subrc
                  'TABL'
                  l_table.       "INS
  endif.

  p_client_dep = no.
  loop at l_dfies into l_dfies_wa
       where datatype = 'CLNT'
                    and keyflag  = 'X'.  "mandantenabhängig, nur wenn
    p_client_dep = yes.                      "Schlüsselfeld!
    exit.
  endloop.
endform.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM ADIC_MESSAGE                                             *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
form adic_message
     using subrc
           m_type
           object.
  case subrc.
    when 1.
*     Objekt nicht vorhanden
      message a701 with m_type object.
    when 2.
*     Objekt besitzt ungültigen Status
      message a702 with m_type object.
    when 4.
*     Objekt nicht vorhanden
      message a704 with m_type object.
    when 5.
*     Objekt gesperrt
      message a705 with m_type object.
    when 7.
*     keine Berechtigung für den Zugriff auf das Objekt
      message a707 with m_type object.
    when 9.
*     Objekt gesperrt
      message a705 with m_type object.
    when 12.
*     Objekt in N-Version
      message a712 with m_type object.
  endcase.
endform.

************************************************************
* INCLUDE LSNR1F02                                         *
* Interne Unterroutinen für Funktionsgruppe SNR1           *
* DB-Schnittstelle                                         *
************************************************************
form read_subobjects
    using p_tablename
          p_fieldname.
* Routine liest die Tabelle TABLENAME und stellt
* für alle gefundenen Zeilen das Feld an der Stelle
* OFFSET in der Länge INTLEN in die Tabelle ISOBJ
  field-symbols: <f> type any, <wa> type any.
  data: l_ref type ref to data.

  create data l_ref type (p_tablename).
  assign l_ref->* to <wa>.
  refresh g_isobj.

  select * from (p_tablename) into <wa>.
      clear g_isobj.
      assign component p_fieldname of structure <wa> to <f>.
      g_isobj-subobject = <f>.
      append g_isobj.
  endselect.
  sort g_isobj.
endform.
* form read_group -------------------------------------------------
* Die Routine liest die Tabelle IOBJECT-NRTAB und stellt sie in die
* interne Tabelle YINRG in das lokale Gedächtnis und kopiert YINRG
* danach für die spätere Änderungsbelegerstellung in die XINRG.
* -----------------------------------------------------------------
form read_group
     changing p_elements  type inrg_tt
              p_grouptext type tnrgt_tt.

  field-symbols: <client>, <subobject>, <element>, <nr>, <nr1>, <nr2>.

  data: l_tnrgt    type table of tnrgt,
        l_tnrgt_wa type tnrgt,
        l_nriv     type table of nriv,
        l_nriv_wa  type nriv,
        l_tabix    type sy-tabix,
        l_subrc    type sy-subrc.

  g_elements_client_dep = no.
  create data ref_elem_tab type standard table of (iobject-nrtab).
  create data ref_elem_tab_wa type (iobject-nrtab).
  assign ref_elem_tab->* to <elem_tab>.
  assign ref_elem_tab_wa->* to <elem_tab_wa>.
  refresh <elem_tab>.
  clear <elem_tab_wa>.

  loop at ntb_group.
    if ntb_group-datatype = 'CLNT'.
      assign component ntb_group-fieldname of structure <elem_tab_wa>
             to  <client>.
      g_elements_client_dep = yes.
    endif.
    case ntb_group-fieldname.
      when iobject-nrintfld.
        assign component ntb_group-fieldname of structure
               <elem_tab_wa> to <nr1>.
      when iobject-nrextfld.
        assign component ntb_group-fieldname of structure
               <elem_tab_wa> to <nr2>.
      when iobject-nrfld.
        assign component ntb_group-fieldname of structure
               <elem_tab_wa> to <nr>.
      when iobject-nrelefld.
        assign component ntb_group-fieldname of structure
               <elem_tab_wa> to <element>.
      when iobject-nrsobjfld.
*       Gruppen abhängig vom Unterobjekt
        if iobject-type = '7' or iobject-type = '8'.
          assign component ntb_group-fieldname of structure
                 <elem_tab_wa> to <subobject>.
        endif.
    endcase.
  endloop.
* Gruppenelemente lesen -------------------------------------------
  refresh: yinrg.
  select * from (iobject-nrtab)
           into table <elem_tab> order by primary key.
* gelesene Elemente aufbereiten und übergeben
  loop at <elem_tab> into <elem_tab_wa>.
    if g_elements_client_dep = yes.
      check <client> = sy-mandt.
    endif.
    clear yinrg.
    if iobject-type = '2' or
       iobject-type = '5' or
       iobject-type = '7'.
       yinrg-nrrgnrk1   = <nr>.
       yinrg-nrrangenr1 = <nr>.
       yinrg-nrrgnrk2   = space.
       yinrg-nrrangenr2 = space.
    else.
       yinrg-nrrgnrk1   = <nr1>.
       yinrg-nrrangenr1 = <nr1>.
       yinrg-nrrgnrk2   = <nr2>.
       yinrg-nrrangenr2 = <nr2>.
    endif.
    if iobject-type = '7' or iobject-type = '8'.
       yinrg-subobject  = <subobject>.
    endif.
    yinrg-element = <element>.
    append yinrg.
  endloop.
  p_elements[] = xinrg[] = yinrg[].
* Gruppentexte lesen ----------------------------------------------
  refresh ytnrgt.
  select * from  tnrgt
           into  table l_tnrgt
           where object = iobject-object.
  loop at l_tnrgt into  l_tnrgt_wa
                  where langu  = sy-langu.
    move-corresponding l_tnrgt_wa to ytnrgt.
    append ytnrgt.
  endloop.
  sort ytnrgt.
  xtnrgt[] = ytnrgt[].
* Änderung wg. Problem, daß Gruppen in verschiedenen Sprachen gepflegt
* Prüfen, ob in einer anderen Sprache Gruppen zum Objekt existieren
*  - ja, prüfen ob diese in Anmeldesprache vorhanden sind
*  - nein, prüfen ob Intervalle dazu existieren, wenn ja Gruppe dazu
  loop at l_tnrgt into  l_tnrgt_wa
                  where langu  <> sy-langu.
*   prüfen, ob Text in Anmeldesprache vorhanden
    read table xtnrgt
         with key client    = l_tnrgt_wa-client
                  langu     = sy-langu
                  object    = l_tnrgt_wa-object
                  subobject = l_tnrgt_wa-subobject
                  number1   = l_tnrgt_wa-number1
                  number2   = l_tnrgt_wa-number2
         binary search.
*   nein: gibt es Element zur Gruppe?
    if sy-subrc <> 0.
      l_subrc = sy-subrc.
      l_tabix = sy-tabix.
*     prüfen, ob Gruppe Elemente besitzt
      read table xinrg with key subobject = l_tnrgt_wa-subobject
                                nrrgnrk1  = l_tnrgt_wa-number1
                                nrrgnrk2  = l_tnrgt_wa-number2.
*     ja, es geht keine Information verloren
      if sy-subrc = 0.
        l_subrc = 0.
*     nein, prüfen, ob Intervalle existieren
*           wenn ja, darf die Texttabelle erweitert werden
      else.
        select * from  nriv
                 into  table l_nriv
                 where object = l_tnrgt_wa-object.
        if l_tnrgt_wa-number1 <> space.
          if iobject-type = '5' or  iobject-type = '6'.
            read table l_nriv
                 with key object    = l_tnrgt_wa-object
                          nrrangenr = l_tnrgt_wa-number1
                 into  l_nriv_wa.
          else.
            read table l_nriv
                 with key object    = l_tnrgt_wa-object
                          subobject = l_tnrgt_wa-subobject
                          nrrangenr = l_tnrgt_wa-number1
                 into  l_nriv_wa.
          endif.
*         Intervall existiert nicht
          if sy-subrc <> 0.
            l_subrc = 0.
          endif.
        endif.
        if l_tnrgt_wa-number2 <> space and l_subrc <> 0.
          if iobject-type = '5' or  iobject-type = '6'.
            read table l_nriv
                 with key object    = l_tnrgt_wa-object
                          nrrangenr = l_tnrgt_wa-number2
                 into  l_nriv_wa.
          else.
            read table l_nriv
                 with key object    = l_tnrgt_wa-object
                          subobject = l_tnrgt_wa-subobject
                          nrrangenr = l_tnrgt_wa-number2
                 into  l_nriv_wa.
          endif.
*         Intervall existiert nicht
          if sy-subrc <> 0.
            l_subrc = 0.
          endif.
        endif.
*       Texttabelle eventuell erweitern oder ändern
        case l_subrc.
          when 0.
          when 4.
            xtnrgt       = l_tnrgt_wa.
            xtnrgt-langu = sy-langu.
                 xtnrgt-txt   = 'Generierter Gruppentext. Bitte ändern'(777).
            xtnrgt-kz    = 'I'.
            insert xtnrgt index l_tabix.
          when 8.
            xtnrgt       = l_tnrgt_wa.
            xtnrgt-langu = sy-langu.
            xtnrgt-txt   = 'Generierter Gruppentext. Bitte ändern'(777).
            xtnrgt-kz    = 'I'.
            append xtnrgt.
        endcase.
      endif.
    endif.
  endloop.
  p_grouptext[] = l_tnrgt[].
endform.

* --- form read_elementtext ---------------------------------------
* Die Routine liest die Tabelle IOBJECT-NRELTXTTAB und stellt das
* Ergebnis in die interne Tabelle XINRET.
* -----------------------------------------------------------------
form read_elementtext
     tables p_inret  structure inret
     using  language type sy-langu.

data: ref_db_tab    type ref to data,
      ref_db_tab_wa type ref to data.
data: l_genkey      type i,
      l_client_dep  type c,
      l_where_tab(72) occurs 1 with header line.

field-symbols: <client>, <language>, <subobject>, <element>, <text>,
               <db_tab> type standard table, <db_tab_wa> type any.

* Zunächst muß der Key generisch gefüllt werden, falls das möglich
* ist. Zum generischen Füllen kommt der Mandant und das Sprachenkz.
* in Frage. Die Felder müssen die ersten beiden Felder der Tabelle sein.
* Ist die Texttabelle mandantenunbah. kommt nur das Sprachenkz. in
* Frage.

* Nametab der Elementtextfelder nach Position sortieren
  sort ntb_elemtext by position.
  create data ref_db_tab type standard table of (iobject-nreltxttab).
  create data ref_db_tab_wa type (iobject-nreltxttab).
  assign ref_db_tab->* to <db_tab>.
  assign ref_db_tab_wa->* to <db_tab_wa>.

  clear ntb_elemtext.
  read table ntb_elemtext index 1.
  if sy-subrc = 0 and
     ntb_elemtext-position  = '0001' and
     ntb_elemtext-datatype  = 'CLNT'.
    assign component ntb_elemtext-fieldname of structure
           <db_tab_wa> to <client>.
    l_genkey = ntb_elemtext-intlen.
  elseif sy-subrc = 0 and
         ntb_elemtext-position  = '0001' and
         ntb_elemtext-fieldname = iobject-nreltxtlng.
    assign component ntb_elemtext-fieldname of structure
           <db_tab_wa> to <language>.
    l_genkey = ntb_elemtext-intlen.
    concatenate ntb_elemtext-fieldname ' EQ' ' ''' language ''''
                into l_where_tab.
    append l_where_tab.
  endif.

  if l_genkey > 0.
*   zweites Feld untersuchen
    clear ntb_elemtext.
    read table ntb_elemtext index 2.
    if sy-subrc = 0 and
       ntb_elemtext-position = '0002' and
       ntb_elemtext-datatype = 'CLNT'.
      assign component ntb_elemtext-fieldname of structure
             <db_tab_wa> to <client>.
      l_genkey  = l_genkey + ntb_elemtext-intlen.
    elseif sy-subrc = 0 and
           ntb_elemtext-position  = '0002' and
           ntb_elemtext-fieldname = iobject-nreltxtlng.
      assign component ntb_elemtext-fieldname of structure
             <db_tab_wa> to <language>.
      l_genkey = l_genkey + ntb_elemtext-intlen.
      concatenate ntb_elemtext-fieldname ' EQ' ' ''' language ''''
                  into l_where_tab.
      append l_where_tab.
    endif.
  endif.

  refresh xinret.
  select * from (iobject-nreltxttab) into table <db_tab>
           where (l_where_tab)
           order by primary key.
  describe table <db_tab> lines sy-tabix.
* Es wurden Texte gefunden
  if sy-tabix > 0.
*   Feldsymbole zuweisen
    l_client_dep = no.
    loop at ntb_elemtext.
      if ntb_elemtext-datatype = 'CLNT'.
        assign component ntb_elemtext-fieldname of structure
               <db_tab_wa> to <client>.
        l_client_dep = yes.
      else.
        case ntb_elemtext-fieldname.
          when iobject-nreltxtlng.
            assign component ntb_elemtext-fieldname of structure
                   <db_tab_wa> to <language>.
          when iobject-nreltxtsob.
            assign component ntb_elemtext-fieldname of structure
                   <db_tab_wa> to <subobject>.
          when iobject-nreltxtele.
            assign component ntb_elemtext-fieldname of structure
                   <db_tab_wa> to <element>.
          when iobject-nreltxttxt.
            assign component ntb_elemtext-fieldname of structure
                   <db_tab_wa> to <text>.
        endcase.
      endif.
    endloop.
*   Texte an aufbereitete Tabelle übergeben
    loop at <db_tab> into <db_tab_wa>.
      if l_client_dep = yes.
        check <client> = sy-mandt.
      endif.
      check <language> = language.
      clear xinret.
      if iobject-nreltxtsob <> space.
        xinret-subobject = <subobject>.
      endif.
      xinret-element = <element>.
      xinret-txt     = <text>.
      append xinret.
    endloop.
    sort xinret.
    p_inret[] = xinret[].
  endif.
endform.                    " READ_ELEMENTTEXT
